title: Add PWA installability and Android TWA packaging guidance

requirements.summary: Add PWA manifest, service worker registration, and offline-capable behavior suitable for Android home-screen install without breaking authenticated navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: A web app manifest is present and linked from the HTML entrypoint so Android/Chrome recognizes the app as installable.
At minimum, the manifest includes: name, short_name, start_url, display=standalone, background_color, theme_color, and icon entries for 192x192 and 512x512 PNGs.

A service worker is registered and provides offline behavior that does not break authenticated navigation (e.g., app shell loads and shows a reasonable offline message/state when network is unavailable).
The app can be installed from Chrome on Android (“Add to Home screen”) and launches in standalone mode without browser chrome.
All user-facing text introduced for install/offline states is in English.

file_operations.description: Link the PWA manifest and set theme-color metadata so Chrome/Android recognizes installability; ensure the manifest reference points to frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest.

Add a web app manifest defining name, short_name, start_url, display=standalone, background_color, theme_color, and icon entries referencing the generated Android icon assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.

Implement an offline-capable service worker that caches the app shell/static assets and provides a safe offline fallback so the shell loads even when network is unavailable (without interfering with authenticated flows).
Register the service worker on app startup (in production contexts) and add basic update/error logging to avoid breaking the current React boot sequence.
Add a small hook to track online/offline state via browser events so the UI can display a reasonable offline state without altering existing auth/actor hooks.
Add an English-only offline banner/message component shown when the device is offline (e.g., 'You are offline. Some features may not be available.').

Wire OfflineBanner into the shared layout so offline status is visible across authenticated and unauthenticated screens without changing any read-only shadcn/ui source files under frontend/src/components/ui.

Adjust existing fallback/error UI to include an English offline hint when the device is offline (e.g., on profile-load failures), ensuring authenticated navigation remains understandable when offline.

requirements.summary: Add documentation describing how to package the production IC URL into an Android APK/AAB using a Trusted Web Activity (TWA) wrapper, including debug APK steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Documentation exists in the frontend repo (e.g., a new markdown file) with step-by-step instructions to generate an Android app wrapper using a TWA approach.
The documentation explicitly states what URL to use for start_url (the production app URL) and how to verify the PWA manifest and icon availability.
The documentation includes steps to build a debug APK locally and notes what is out of scope (e.g., Play Store publishing/signing) unless configured by the developer.

file_operations.description: Create TWA build guidance documenting required parameters (production start URL and manifest URL), how to verify manifest/icon availability in production, how to generate Android wrapper artifacts (APK/AAB) via a TWA approach, and how to produce a local debug APK; explicitly note Play Store publishing/signing is out of scope unless configured.
Add a short reference/link to frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md in the existing deployment documentation so developers can discover the Android packaging instructions.

requirements.summary: Add Android-appropriate 192x192 and 512x512 app icon assets and reference them from the web manifest for consistent branding.
acceptanceCriteria: Two new icon assets are available under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced by the web manifest: a 192x192 PNG and a 512x512 PNG.
The manifest icon paths resolve correctly when the app is deployed (HTTP 200 for icon URLs).
Icons are visually consistent with the existing Han’s Laser branding already used by the site favicon/apple-touch-icon.

file_operations.description: Add the generated 192x192 PNG Android app icon asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png (Han’s Laser themed, high-contrast, simplified mark).
Add the generated 512x512 PNG Android app icon asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png (Han’s Laser themed, high-contrast, simplified mark).

Ensure the manifest icon entries reference the exact generated files frontend/public/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png with correct sizes and types.
